summary: Retested inscricao-online bug fix on /inicio.html. Fix (delegated document click listener) works correctly on both desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844). data-testid=link-inscricao-online shows page-loader for ~2s then navigates to /termos.html. data-testid=btn-inscricao-online also works. Bullet links under 'Inscrição On-line' (e.g., 'Solicitação de Isenção' with href=inicio.html) correctly stay on home with no loader, no navigation to /termos.
